meta.scope: Indonesia Batch 13 — Major ports (Tanjung Priok, Tanjung Perak and system), ethnic groups & regional language diversity (Long Form SP2020), and crime / security statistics. Continues the dig into the areas the user flagged as interesting.

candidates.title: Tanjung Priok Port operational statistics
candidates.description: Operational statistics for Indonesia’s principal container and logistics gateway port — vessel calls, container throughput (recently ~8.3 million TEUs), non-container cargo and related indicators. Central node in the national and international shipping system.
referenced_by: Foreign trade and inter-island trade nodes

candidates.title: Tanjung Perak Port operational statistics
candidates.description: Operational statistics for Tanjung Perak — major passenger and domestic-cargo hub in East Java. Frequently ranks among the busiest ports for inter-island passenger and cargo volumes.
referenced_by: Inter-island trade and East Java provincial nodes
candidates.notes: Primary eastern-Java / domestic inter-island port node.

candidates.title: Major Indonesian ports system (Belawan, Makassar, and others)
candidates.publisher: Pelindo / BPS / Ministry of Transportation related
candidates.description: System-level view of the main commercial ports that handle the bulk of international and inter-island cargo and passengers. Complements the detailed Priok and Perak nodes and links to the chokepoint and connectivity layers.
referenced_by: Tanjung Priok and Tanjung Perak nodes

candidates.title: Profile of Ethnic Groups (Long Form Population Census 2020)
candidates.description: Official socio-demographic profiles of major ethnic groups drawn from the Long Form SP2020 — age/sex composition, island distribution, concentration, fertility, marriage age, life expectancy, migration, education, and languages spoken. Captures the extreme ethnic diversity of the archipelago.
referenced_by: Population Census and Long Form results
candidates.notes: Foundational ethnic-diversity node. Complements the religious-composition series.

candidates.title: Regional language diversity statistics (Long Form SP2020)
candidates.description: Statistics on the use of regional languages within families and communities, and the diversity of local languages by island. Documents the linguistic plurality that sits alongside Indonesian as the national language.
candidates.notes: Linguistic-diversity counterpart to the ethnic and religious nodes.

candidates.title: Crime Statistics (Statistik Kriminal)
candidates.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia (Police registration + Susenas + Podes)
candidates.description: Annual crime statistics combining police administrative records (crime total, crime rate, crime clock), Susenas victimisation data, and Village Potential (Podes) indicators of local crime incidence. Reporting rates to police remain relatively low.
candidates.notes: Core security and justice statistical product.

candidates.title: Crime victimisation and reporting-rate statistics
candidates.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia (Susenas component of Crime Statistics)
candidates.description: Survey-based measures of the share of the population that experiences crime and the rate at which incidents are reported to the police. Complements the administrative crime-count series.
candidates.notes: Victim-side densification of the security cluster.

candidates.title: Indonesia ports–ethnicity–language–crime densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from Pelindo, BPS Long Form and Crime Statistics sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding major port operational statistics (Tanjung Priok, Tanjung Perak, system), ethnic-group profiles, regional-language diversity, crime statistics and victimisation measures into a coherent infrastructure–identity–security layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
